data.desc: Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. (NYSE American: OPTT) provides intelligent maritime systems and services for defense and security, offshore energy, science and research, and offshore wind. Its PowerBuoy platforms deliver clean, renewable power and real-time data communications for remote maritime and subsea applications. The company also offers the WAM-V autonomous surface vehicle and Merrows software for multi-domain awareness. For more information, visit www.oceanpowertechnologies.com.
